author: More Perfect Union
description:
When meat-packing giant Tyson closed a huge plant in Nebraska, a state hit hard by Trump policies lost another $3 billion.

Now Independent Dan Osborn could take a long-time GOP Senate seat.

He says he's running to represent working people betrayed by companies like Tyson.
